name: setup-compatibility
lines: Can Playback work with our setup? We have an iPad and want to send the tracks wirelessly to a Bluetooth sound system for Sunday worship.
Yes, I'd like to speak with a specialist.
expect: Consult documentation before making compatibility claims. If this setup is unsupported or cannot be verified, explain the limit briefly and offer a human specialist without inventing performance numbers or promising a workaround. On acceptance use the existing availability and simulated handoff/callback flow.
